# Enclii

> Open source DevOps platform for deploying, scaling, and operating containerized
> services with enterprise-grade security, GitOps automation, and zero vendor lock-in.
> Go backend + Next.js frontend + ArgoCD GitOps + Cloudflare Tunnel zero-trust ingress.

Enclii is MADFAM's production DevOps platform running on a 2-node k3s cluster on Hetzner +
Cloudflare. It dogfoods itself — the control plane runs on Enclii. Authentication
is handled by Janua SSO (OIDC/RS256 JWT). GitOps via ArgoCD App-of-Apps with
10 apps in `infra/argocd/apps/` (incl. 1 ApplicationSet for projects).

---

## Agent Directives (AI_CONTEXT.md)

### Architecture
- **Stack**: Go (Gin) backend + Next.js 16 frontend + K3s + ArgoCD
- **Pattern**: GitOps, App-of-Apps, zero-trust ingress via Cloudflare Tunnel
- **Self-Deployment**: Enclii deploys itself (dogfooding)
- **Cluster**: 2-node k3s v1.33.6+k3s1 (foundry-core + foundry-builder-01)

### God Files (Critical Paths)

| Purpose | Path |
|---------|------|
| API Entry | `apps/switchyard-api/cmd/api/main.go` |
| CLI Entry | `packages/cli/cmd/enclii/main.go` |
| Login Flow | `packages/cli/internal/cmd/login.go` |
| Terraform | `infra/terraform/` |
| K8s Manifests | `infra/k8s/production/` |
| ArgoCD Root | `infra/argocd/root-application.yaml` |
| ArgoCD Apps | `infra/argocd/apps/*.yaml` (10 apps incl. network-policies, vault, posthog) |
| Tunnel Config | `infra/k8s/production/cloudflared-unified.yaml` (54 ingress rules, auto-provisioned via enclii.yaml, incl. vault.enclii.dev + analytics.enclii.dev) |
| Kyverno Policies | `infra/k8s/base/kyverno/policies/` |
| Golden Tests | `tests/golden/` (pre-commit validation) |
| Enclii Config | `.enclii.yml` |
| Dispatch API | `apps/dispatch/` |
| Infra Anatomy | `docs/infrastructure/INFRA_ANATOMY.md` |
| llms.txt | `llms.txt` (this file's compact version) |
| llms-full.txt | `llms-full.txt` (this file) |

### Port Allocation
- 4200: Switchyard API (api.enclii.dev)
- 4201: Switchyard UI (app.enclii.dev)
- 4202: Agent
- 4203: Dispatch (admin.enclii.dev)
- 4204: Status Page (status.enclii.dev, status.madfam.io)
- 4290: Metrics

### The Tripod
- **Depends On**: Janua for authentication (auth.madfam.io)
- **Orchestrates**: All MADFAM services via K8s/ArgoCD
- **Does NOT use**: @madfam/ui (independent Radix UI components)
- **Self-Deploys**: Control plane runs on Enclii itself

### Agent Rules
1. ALWAYS run `golangci-lint run` before Go commits
2. ALWAYS run `pnpm typecheck` before TypeScript commits
3. CHECK `git status && git branch` at session start
4. USE feature branches for all changes
5. READ AI_CONTEXT.md at session start
6. **Proof of Life Standard:** No task is "Complete" until you `curl` the public endpoint and get 200 OK (or 401 for protected routes). "Kubernetes Applied" is NOT "Done."

### Secret Management (Safe-Patch Mode)
- **Backup First**: `cp .env .env.bak` before any modification
- **Patch, Don't Purge**: Never overwrite with `> .env`. Use `sed` or `echo >>`.
- **Placeholder Ban**: Never write `your_key_here`, `placeholder`, `example`, `xxx`, or `TODO` into `.env` files.

### Self-Deployment Flow
```
Git push → GitHub webhook → Roundhouse build → ArgoCD sync → K8s deployment
                          ↳ Parse enclii.yaml → Auto-provision domains (tunnel routes + DNS CNAMEs)
```

### External Repo Auto-Deploy Flow
```
Git push → CI build → GHCR push → digest commit to kustomization.yaml → ArgoCD sync
         ↳ POST /v1/callbacks/lifecycle-event (tracks push_received → image_pushed → deploy_healthy)
```

### Deployment Lifecycle Tracking
- Events: push_received, build_started, build_succeeded, image_pushed, deploy_synced, deploy_healthy
- Query: GET /v1/lifecycle/timeline/:owner/:repo, /branch/:owner/:repo/:branch, /commit/:sha
- Callback: POST /v1/callbacks/lifecycle-event (bearer token auth)
- Branch→env mapping: main→production, staging/*→staging, feature/*→preview

### Self-Service Onboarding
- POST /v1/admin/onboard — validates enclii.yaml, creates project/services, generates ArgoCD app YAML
- GET /v1/admin/onboard — list onboarded repos
- Guides: [Deployment Tracking](./docs/guides/DEPLOYMENT_TRACKING.md), [Onboarding](./docs/guides/ONBOARDING_GUIDE.md), [External Repos](./docs/guides/EXTERNAL_REPO_DEPLOY.md)

## System Architecture (SYSTEM_CONTEXT.md)

### Component Map

| Component | Port | Domain | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| Switchyard API | 4200 (container) / 80 (K8s) | api.enclii.dev | Control plane API |
| Switchyard UI | 4201 (container) / 80 (K8s) | app.enclii.dev | User dashboard |
| Dispatch | 4203 (container) / 80 (K8s) | admin.enclii.dev | Infrastructure control tower |
| Landing Page | 80 (container) / 80 (K8s) | enclii.dev | Marketing site |
| Docs | 80 (container) / 80 (K8s) | docs.enclii.dev | Documentation |

### Dispatch (Admin UI)
Superuser interface for managing infrastructure — domains, tunnels, ecosystem resources.

**Authorization Model:**
- Email domain must be in `ALLOWED_ADMIN_DOMAINS` (default: `@madfam.io`)
- User role must be in `ALLOWED_ADMIN_ROLES` (default: `superadmin,admin,operator`)

**Key Files:**
| Purpose | Location |
|---------|----------|
| Middleware (server-side auth) | `apps/dispatch/middleware.ts` |
| Auth Context (client-side) | `apps/dispatch/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` |
| K8s Deployment | `apps/dispatch/k8s/deployment.yaml` |
| Dockerfile | `apps/dispatch/Dockerfile` |

### Cloudflare Tunnel (Zero-Trust Ingress)
```
Internet → Cloudflare Edge → cloudflared pods → K8s Service:80 → Container:4xxx
           (TLS, DDoS)        (2 replicas)       (ClusterIP)      (targetPort)
```

Key routes in `cloudflared-unified.yaml`:
- `admin.enclii.dev` → `dispatch.enclii.svc.cluster.local:80`
- `app.enclii.dev` → `switchyard-ui.enclii.svc.cluster.local:80`
- `api.enclii.dev` → `switchyard-api.enclii.svc.cluster.local:80`
- `vault.enclii.dev` → `vault.vault.svc.cluster.local:8200` (502 — backend pending deploy)
- `analytics.enclii.dev` → `posthog-web.posthog.svc.cluster.local:8000` (502 — backend pending deploy)

### Kubernetes Resources

| Resource | Namespace | Purpose |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| `switchyard-api` | enclii | Control plane API |
| `switchyard-ui` | enclii | User dashboard |
| `dispatch` | enclii | Admin interface |
| `status-enclii` | enclii | Status page (status.enclii.dev) |
| `status-madfam` | enclii | Status page (status.madfam.io) |
| `status-recorder-*` | enclii | CronJob — records status history every 60s |
| `cloudflared` | cloudflare-tunnel | Ingress tunnel |

### Authentication
- Provider: **Janua** (auth.madfam.io)
- Protocol: OIDC with RS256 JWT
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_JANUA_URL`: `https://auth.madfam.io`

### Critical Environment Variables

```yaml
# Dispatch
ALLOWED_ADMIN_DOMAINS: "@madfam.io"
ALLOWED_ADMIN_ROLES: "superadmin,admin,operator"
NEXT_PUBLIC_JANUA_URL: "https://auth.madfam.io"
```

### Operation Ratchet — Rules of Engagement

**Rule 1:** Always run `./scripts/validate.sh --golden` before confirming any task complete.

**Rule 2:** Never remove protected config keys:
| Key | File | Impact |
|-----|------|--------|
| `ENCLII_OIDC_ISSUER` | environment-patch.yaml | Breaks SSO |
| `ENCLII_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | environment-patch.yaml | Breaks SSO |
| `ALLOWED_ADMIN_DOMAINS` | dispatch/deployment.yaml | Breaks admin access |
| `imagePullSecrets:` | roundhouse.yaml, dispatch/deployment.yaml | Breaks image pulls |
| `hostname: api.enclii.dev` | cloudflared-unified.yaml | Breaks API routing |
| `hostname: auth.madfam.io` | cloudflared-unified.yaml | Breaks Janua SSO |

**Rule 3:** Verify `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` env vars in Dockerfiles for Next.js apps.

**Rule 4:** If golden config fails, review the diff — update with `./scripts/update-golden.sh` only if intentional.

## Development Guide (CLAUDE.md Summary)

### Common Commands

```bash
# Setup
make bootstrap          # Install hooks, dependencies
make kind-up            # Create local kind cluster

# Run services locally
make run-switchyard     # API on :8080
make run-ui             # UI on :3000

# Build & test
make build-all          # Build all components
make test               # Unit tests
make e2e                # End-to-end tests
make lint               # Linters (golangci-lint, eslint, prettier)
make precommit          # All checks before committing
```

### Key File Locations

**API (Go):**
| Purpose | Location |
|---------|----------|
| Entry point | `apps/switchyard-api/cmd/api/main.go` |
| HTTP handlers | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/api/*.go` |
| Route registration | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/api/*_handlers.go` (distributed, no centralized router) |
| Middleware | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/middleware/` |
| Services | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/services/` |
| Admin handlers | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/api/*_handlers.go` |
| Admin services | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/services/` |
| enclii.yaml parser | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/api/enclii_yaml.go` |
| Domain provisioner | `apps/switchyard-api/internal/api/domain_provisioner.go` |

**CLI (Go):**
| Purpose | Location |
|---------|----------|
| Entry point | `packages/cli/cmd/enclii/main.go` |
| Commands | `packages/cli/internal/cmd/` |
| API client | `packages/cli/internal/api/` |
| Auth flow | `packages/cli/internal/auth/` |

**UI (Next.js):**
| Purpose | Location |
|---------|----------|
| App router | `apps/switchyard-ui/app/` |
| Components | `apps/switchyard-ui/components/` |
| API calls | `apps/switchyard-ui/lib/api/` |
| Hooks | `apps/switchyard-ui/hooks/` |

**Infrastructure:**
| Purpose | Location |
|---------|----------|
| Terraform | `infra/terraform/` |
| K8s manifests | `infra/k8s/production/` |
| Cloudflare tunnel | `infra/k8s/production/cloudflared-unified.yaml` |
| ArgoCD config | `infra/argocd/` |
| ArgoCD apps | `infra/argocd/apps/*.yaml` |
| Longhorn values | `infra/helm/longhorn/` |

### Deployment Flow
1. Build via Nixpacks/Buildpacks or Dockerfile
2. Create immutable Release with provenance (git SHA, SBOM, signature)
3. Deploy with canary/blue-green strategies
4. Automatic rollback on failure based on SLO metrics

### Error Handling
- Exit codes: 0 (success), 10 (validation), 20 (build failed), 30 (deploy failed), 40 (timeout), 50 (auth)
- Automatic rollback triggers when error rate > 2% for 2 minutes

### Platform SLOs
- Control plane API availability: 99.95% monthly
- Build subsystem availability: 99.9% monthly
- Preview environment provisioning: P95 < 3 minutes
- Deploy to stage: P95 ≤ 8 minutes for typical Node/Go services

### Security Conventions
- Never commit secrets — use Lockbox/Vault
- All images signed with cosign
- SBOM required for all releases
- Admission policies enforced via Kyverno/OPA
- Trunk-based development on `main` with conventional commits

### Debugging Quick Reference

| Symptom | Check | Fix |
|---------|-------|-----|
| API 500 errors | `enclii logs switchyard-api` | Check DB connection, env vars |
| Build stuck | `kubectl get jobs -n enclii-builds` | Restart Roundhouse worker |
| Auth fails | `curl .../jwks.json` | Check Janua status, OIDC config |
| Deploy timeout | `kubectl describe deploy` | Check resource limits, probes |
| SSL errors | Cert-manager logs | Check issuer, DNS |

---

## Production Infrastructure

### Compute (2-node k3s cluster)
- **foundry-core** (Hetzner AX41-NVMe): Control plane — AMD Ryzen 5 3600, 64GB RAM, 2x512GB NVMe
- **foundry-builder-01** (Hetzner Cloud VPS): CI builder — tainted `builder=true:NoSchedule`
- **k3s v1.33.6+k3s1**: Lightweight Kubernetes

### Ingress
- **Cloudflare Tunnel**: Zero-trust, zero exposed ports, 2 replica `cloudflared` pods
- **Port Mapping**: Container:4xxx → K8s Service:80 → Cloudflare Route

### Data
- **PostgreSQL**: In-cluster with PVC, daily R2 backups
- **Redis**: In-cluster single instance (Sentinel ready)
- **Cloudflare R2**: Object storage (SBOMs, artifacts)
- **Longhorn CSI**: Block storage (single-replica, multi-node ready)

### GitOps
- **ArgoCD**: App-of-Apps with self-heal and drift correction
- **Config**: `infra/argocd/` (root-application.yaml + apps/*.yaml)

### Authentication
- **Janua SSO**: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 with RS256 JWT (auth.madfam.io)
- **GitHub OAuth**: Repository imports
- **RBAC**: Admin/Developer/Viewer roles
- **Session Management**: Redis-backed
- **API Keys**: CI/CD service accounts

---

## ArgoCD App-of-Apps Overview

The root application at `infra/argocd/root-application.yaml` manages 10 child applications defined in `infra/argocd/apps/`:

Core Enclii services, Janua SSO services, Dhanam services, Cloudflare tunnel, Longhorn storage, and supporting infrastructure. Each app syncs from its respective Git repository with automated self-heal.

---

## Components

- [apps/switchyard-api/](./apps/switchyard-api/): Control plane API (Go/Gin, port 4200)
- [apps/switchyard-ui/](./apps/switchyard-ui/): Web dashboard (Next.js, port 4201)
- [apps/dispatch/](./apps/dispatch/): Admin platform (Next.js, port 4203)
- [packages/cli/](./packages/cli/): CLI (`enclii` command, Go/Cobra)
- [packages/sdk-go/](./packages/sdk-go/): Go SDK — API client (`pkg/client/`) and type definitions (`pkg/types/`)
- [apps/roundhouse/](./apps/roundhouse/): Build pipeline workers (Kaniko)
- [apps/status/](./apps/status/): Status page (port 4204) — real-time health checks + 24h historical timeline (PostgreSQL-backed, 15-min windows)
- [apps/waybill/](./apps/waybill/): Infrastructure cost metering (customer billing via Dhanam)
- [apps/docs-site/](./apps/docs-site/): Documentation (Docusaurus)
- [apps/landing/](./apps/landing/): Landing page (Next.js)

## Integrations

- [Janua SSO](https://github.com/madfam-org/janua): auth.madfam.io — OIDC/RS256 JWT authentication
- [Dhanam](https://github.com/madfam-org/dhanam): dhan.am — managed by ArgoCD
- [Integration Docs](./docs/integrations/)
